extracted_factors.Label: Zero-Deforestation Commitments
extracted_factors.Tags: ZDC, palm oil sector, environmental targets
extracted_factors.Description: Corporate pledges made by companies not to purchase products grown on deforested land, aiming to reduce environmental and socio-economic risks.

extracted_factors.Label: Traceability
extracted_factors.Description: The ability to track palm oil products back to their source; crucial for ensuring compliance with zero-deforestation commitments.

extracted_factors.Label: Smallholder Inclusion
extracted_factors.Tags: socio-economic, palm oil industry, small-scale farmers
extracted_factors.Description: Ensuring smallholder farmers are incorporated into the supply chain policies, to prevent their exclusion from markets.

extracted_factors.Label: Deforestation Risk
extracted_factors.Description: The probability of forested areas being converted for agricultural or industrial use, threatening ecological preservation.

extracted_factors.Label: Compliance Support for High-Risk Mills
extracted_factors.Tags: palm oil industry, supply chain risk management
extracted_factors.Description: Programs and engagements designed to help high-risk mills meet environmental standards and zero-deforestation commitments.

extracted_factors.Label: EU Deforestation Regulation
extracted_factors.Description: A regulatory framework that places due diligence requirements on companies dealing with forest-risk commodities, influencing company policy formulations.

extracted_factors.Label: Transparency
extracted_factors.Description: The disclosure of information regarding grievance systems, monitoring, and policy enforcement, necessary for evaluating ZDC effectiveness.

extracted_factors.Label: Economic Impact on Smallholders
extracted_factors.Description: The result of supply chain policies that may affect market access and income for smallholder farmers in the palm oil sector.

extracted_factors.Label: Forest at Risk of Conversion
extracted_factors.Description: Forested areas that face a high risk of being converted into agricultural or plantation land, particularly in the context of palm oil expansion.
